title: Global Environment Facility — Senegal, climate transparency data platform (CBIT-Sénégal), 2025
description:
From the project document, verbatim:

> Senegal has insufficient capacity to comply with the Enhanced Transparency Framework (ETF) of
> Article 13 of the Paris Agreement (PA) due to restricted exposure to previous transparency
> initiatives.

> This project objective is to enhance the National Framework for Climate Transparency for
> Senegal to meet the requirements of the ETF under the Paris Agreement on Climate Change. The
> project aims to fill critical information gaps, align with sustainable development goals,
> including gender equality and foster transparency and good governance, enabling Senegal to
> manage climate-related data and more effectively prepare fully transparent reports to the
> United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).

> By improving the climate data management cycle—from planning and data collection to analysis
> and information sharing— Senegal will produce high-quality climate information for
> international reporting and national decision-making.

Three technical components: an **Integrated National Transparency Platform (NTP)** with the
governance frameworks, data flows, expertise and tools around it; **NTP modules** for the GHG
inventory, adaptation/vulnerability, NDC tracking, support needed and received, and
capacity-building needs; and **incorporation of the NTP into UNFCCC reporting and national
planning processes** via a roadmap, protocols and tools. Expected to benefit **120 individuals,
40% of them women**.
